mainText: Hello, Verona! At 6 PM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying 75 degrees with clear skies near Reddan Soccer Park. We are under a New Moon, and you can catch the International Space Station crossing the sky tonight starting at 8:19 PM, passing from the direction of Mount Horeb over toward the Fitchburg and Madison area. The overnight low will dip to 58 degrees, with no rain expected.

In city news, the Verona Police Department is now taking applications for their Citizen Academy. This free program runs on Wednesdays from September 23 to November 18 and covers topics like O W I investigations, use of force, and crime scene processing. Additionally, the city has updated its engineering reports for the council and posted necessary election notices for the upcoming November general election.

Your local calendar is busy. Today features Yoga at Insight Wellness and Hop Haus Trivia. Tomorrow, enjoy live music at Bailey's Run Vineyard and the Wisconsin Brewing Company. Looking ahead, the Dane County Farmer's Market is this Saturday, followed by the exciting Ironman Wisconsin Loop Festival in Verona on Saturday and various trivia events next week.

Regarding local reports, the department confirmed that on Sunday, August 30, they began an investigation into a sexual assault of a child by a school staff member, which led to an arrest on September 4.
Today's flavor of the day is the delicious Dark Chocolate Decadence. The Verona location is currently open and will be serving customers until 10:00 PM this evening.
